mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 100), manufacturing output slowdowns increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% annually, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate severe demand sector slowdowns that trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession risks.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST above 1500 thousand units), strong housing market activity signals robust consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
